description: Repository paths outside a crate that Rust code reads, and in-crate documentation (.md, .mdx) that include_str!/include_bytes! compiles in, and their readers.
Keys are exact repository paths, directory prefixes ending in '/', or './' for a reader of the whole checkout.

Each reader names the package and target holding the reference, its scope (target: test-only code; package: library, binary or build-script code any test of the package can reach), optional nextest test names, and the source files.
scripts/ci-non-rust-readers-guard.mjs regenerates the facts from the sources and fails on any difference; scripts/ci-non-rust-readers.mjs maps changed paths onto readers.

not_readers.why: Derives a realm id from the checkout path; reads nothing under it.
The schema emitter (make regen-schemas) writes artifacts/schemas; no test reads it through this binary.
Lowers the configured workspace confinement for the host's runtime workspace; reads nothing in the checkout.
Writes the generated protocol files; the drift check that reads them is listed under their paths.
